name: Asset compare (p300 codec variants)
description: p300 Phase 1d: the codec variants of phase1Variants.ts against their uncompressed baselines. A tiled rock ground at grazing angles, a MetalRust sphere and the metal toolbox prop, built twice (slots A and B); V switches between them. Debug env: the scene's own "Asset compare" tab picks the variants, shows each texture's file size and VRAM, and runs the collider check.
